title: Shared-git-index race upgraded from cosmetic to FUNCTIONAL: P2-F git mv fragmented (duplicate + dangling deletion)

payload.prior_incident: commit 6fc9b721 (2026-05-24) — cosmetic cross-pilot conflation, no work lost

this_incident.symptom: intended `git mv` fragmented into ADD-new + dangling-uncommitted-DELETE
this_incident.committed_state_HEAD: pkg/domain/services.go + services_test.go STILL TRACKED (orphaned dead code) AND pkg/domain/_deprecated/services_v1.go + services_v1_test.go ADDED (duplicate). 6225f926 shows the _deprecated files as pure additions (+72/+173), not renames.
this_incident.working_tree_state: services.go + services_test.go deleted (unstaged) — the correct intended end-state, but never committed
this_incident.buildable: both HEAD and working tree compile (old domain service unused after FetchPriceUseCase rewire to PriceResolverPort) — NOT a build break, but HEAD is inconsistent and PM AC-1 ('original paths gone') was verified against a transient index state, not HEAD
this_incident.pm_verification_gap: PM commit 46880726 graded P2-F AC-1 PASS on 'git status R rename' observed transiently; committed truth differs

payload.root_cause: All concurrent pilot committers share ONE git worktree + ONE index. dev-kinh-dich (P1-F) ran `git reset HEAD <stock-price staged deletion>` to clear foreign paths from the shared index before its own commit; this STRANDED stock-price's staged deletion of services.go/services_test.go. dev-stock-price (P2-F) then re-staged only its new+modified files and never re-added the deletion -> fragmented move. The defensive WAIT-before-stage guard is INSUFFICIENT when any agent uses `git reset` on foreign paths (predicted in memory feedback_concurrent_commit_race.md).
payload.interim_policy_adopted_by_router: FLEET-WIDE SINGLE-COMMITTER SERIALIZATION — at most ONE file-committing worker in flight across ALL pilots until the structural fix lands. Long read/build/test phases may still overlap; tag-only ops (git tag) remain safe-concurrent (ref, not index). The WAIT guard stays in place as defense-in-depth, but agents MUST NOT `git reset HEAD` foreign paths — they WAIT instead.
payload.remediation_in_progress: dev-stock-price dispatched to stage+commit the dangling deletion of pkg/domain/services.go + services_test.go (completing the G5a move), re-verify go build + golangci-lint + sandbox green, confirm anchor intact, and write an honest evidence note. PM to then correct the P2-F record (AC-1 truthful).

requested_decision.to_architect: Design the structural fix that eliminates the shared-index race. Leading option: per-pilot git worktrees (each pilot commits to its own working tree + index, periodically integrated to main). Alternative: a commit-mutex/lock protocol. Output an architecture brief.
requested_decision.to_po: Ratify the interim single-committer serialization policy and authorize the structural-fix design effort. Confirm whether the P2-F record correction needs a formal re-grade or an evidence addendum suffices (no G-goal is flipped either way — Charter 4.5).

invariants_intact.no_history_rewrite: true — remediation is a forward commit, no rebase/reset-hard/amend
